== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">＊タスケン・レイダーの合計戦闘力は、その場所にいる人数の合計で変化する。合計戦闘力は、１名であれば１、２名＝３、３名＝６、４名＝１０となる。１つの位置カードには４名までしかおけない。タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">別称サンド・ピープル。ゴーグルと呼吸マスクを顔に装着している。バンサに騎乗し、ガッフィの杖を振るう。好戦的で、砂漠で生活する。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tusken Raider]].

'''Lore''' — Also called Sand People. They wear goggles and a breath mask on the face. They ride banthas and swing gaffi sticks. They are warlike and live in the desert.

'''Game text''' — The total power of Tusken Raiders changes with how many are at that place. Total power is 1 for one, 3 for two, 6 for three, and 10 for four. No more than four may be placed on one location card. They may deploy only to Tatooine, but from there they may move wherever you like.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore omits the English Tusken cry and “nomadic, desert survival experts”. Weapon is ガッフィの杖. Cap is 位置カード. Movement is 好きなところへ.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-tuskenraider-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Tusken Raider]].</ref>
